===Sydney Region===
Within the Sydney region, this rainforest community occurs in the deeply sheltered gullies of the [[Hacking River]] and around [[Lady Carrington Drive]] in [[Royal National Park]], with less diverse stands found in [[Ku-ring-gai Chase National Park]].
Within the Sydney region, the ''Northern Warm Temperate Rainforest'' community occurs in the deeply sheltered gullies of the [[Hacking River]] and around [[Lady Carrington Drive]] in [[Royal National Park]], with less diverse stands found in [[Ku-ring-gai Chase National Park]].<ref name=Ryde/>


''Coastal Sandstone Gallery Rainforest'' has relatively low plant species diversity compared with rainforest communities occurring on more fertile soils. Unlike many other rainforest types, it generally lacks an extensive array of climbing vines and [[liana]]s. Instead, the ground layer consists of scattered ferns growing among sandstone [[boulder]]s and fallen logs. Within the [[Sydney]] region, the community occurs in narrow, isolated patches confined to deeply incised gullies and areas of sandstone [[alluvium]] on [[Hawkesbury Sandstone]]. It is associated with areas receiving relatively high annual rainfall, generally exceeding 900 mm, and is more commonly found in the eastern parts of the [[Hornsby Plateau]] and [[Woronora Plateau]]. Other occurrences are found in the hinterland of the [[Hawkesbury River]], the lower [[Blue Mountains]] and the eastern [[Hunter Region]]. The community is represented in several protected areas, including [[Lane Cove National Park]], Dharawal Nature Reserve, [[Ku-ring-gai Chase National Park]], [[Royal National Park]], [[Georges River National Park]], [[Garigal National Park]] and [[Sydney Harbour National Park]].
